scope: Synthetic transcript on a beep fixture. Speech recognition, forced alignment and real speech are not exercised.

checks.name: no transcript: the panel says so and offers import; it does not invent text
checks.detail: אין תמלול לקליפ הזה. זיהוי דיבור אינו מוגדר במחשב זה, ולכן לא נוצר תמלול אוטומטי. אפשר לייבא קובץ כתוביות שמתוזמן מול המדיה המקורית.

checks.name: editor: 8 word buttons; clicking word 6 seeks to 00:00:05:00; shift-click selects 2 words; delete cuts them from every track and marks them as cut
editor: correcting a phrase commits correct_transcript and keeps the original
editor: no uncaught errors
transcript, caption track and clip are created through the normal transaction path
transcript sense returns phrase and word ids with source times and the timing grade
a client cannot label typed text as speech recognition (set_transcript refuses origin=asr)
observer token cannot change a transcript
frame 1 (0.033 s): first word is current; frame 15 (0.5 s): nothing is current; frame 31: second word
rendered karaoke frames: highlighted pixels grow as words are spoken (1 word < 2 words < 4 words)
delete_transcript_range reports the exact frame range it removed
captions follow the cut with no re-timing op: removed words are gone; phrase 1 holds until its source end; "בדיקה" (source 4.0 s) becomes current exactly at timeline frame 87
export: 207 frames; frame 59 shows source 59 and frame 60 shows source 93 (exact cut)
export audio: the two deleted beeps are gone and the next word is heard at 2.900 s (within 2 ms)
export picture: the caption changes phrase on the same frame as the beep (87): exported frames 86 and 87 match the stills of those frames and differ from each other
SRT export reflects the edit and matches the picture: phrase 1 without the deleted words until 2.9 s, then phrase 2
undo restores the cut on every track and the captions
correcting a word changes the caption, keeps word timing, keeps the original text, and leaves exported audio bit-identical
changing the word count marks times as estimates: no word highlight is drawn, and a word-precise cut is refused with a reason

detail.refuse: these words only have estimated times, so a word-precise cut would be a guess

checks.name: SRT import creates frame-snapped cues and reports the largest timing shift
VTT export round-trips text exactly and times to the frame grid
ASS export carries the play resolution and the cues
overlapping import is rejected as a whole, not partly applied
a caption font that is not bundled blocks export instead of silently falling back

detail.message: font "Not Installed Sans" is not bundled with the renderer; text would silently fall back

checks.name: caption renders match the committed baselines (SSIM ≥ 0.995), or were written on first run
silence analysis finds the 8 gaps between beeps, proposes 8 frame-aligned cuts, and edits nothing
applying the candidates as one transaction keeps every beep (8 onsets), closes the gaps evenly, and cannot be applied twice
animate_clip: title is invisible on its first frame, partly visible mid-entrance, fully visible at rest, fading again near the end
all 5 catalog families render differently from each other (none fell back to another face), and the export manifest pins the font files by SHA-256
editor: "find silences" lists candidates without editing; "remove" applies them as one undoable step
editor: one Ctrl+Z restores every removed silence
editor: entrance preset writes keyframes on the selected title; font picker changes its family; no uncaught errors

"sidecar" export: the picture has no captions while the default export has them burned in; the subtitle file is timed to the exported range (cues shifted by the 1 s range start and clipped at its end)
animated GIF export: 30 frames at 320×180, looping, each frame close to the still of the same frame (256-colour palette), and the plan warns that a GIF is silent
agent reads the transcript, deletes one word by id, and reads back captions without that word
